nativeEditorTests.scope: Native compiled shared editor page with synthetic devices. Exercises category buttons, independent drafts, real reset buttons, missing-device undo, native browse invocation, preset selection through the same production callback, responsive layout and readable Light/Dark states.
nativeEditorTests.boundaries: No real registry or PnP writes, driver changes, administrator app launch or real hardware enumeration. Version label changed back to 0.1.1 after UI verification; this record asserts editor behavior, not UI verification of unrelated pages.

boundaries: Focused checks for this maintenance change; not the entire repository test suite.
Memory display names are local to the editor; actual hardware and performance do not change.
Windows may reset friendly names; firmware, WMI or other tools may show the real model.
Real hardware writes and restoration have not been run as an implicit test on the user's computer.
The cloud update manifest remains unchanged; equal 0.1.1 version numbers do not trigger an automatic update prompt.
